CREATE TABLE translation_cache (
	key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	value JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE quality_reports (
	draft_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	draft_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	issues JSONB NOT NULL, 
	valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES translation_drafts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE dispatch_permits (
	attempt_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	control_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	price_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	reserved_micro BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	actual_micro BIGINT, 
	state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (attempt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES attempts (id)
)
